from participation_rate_operation_settings settings inner join evaluation_rule_versions versions on versions.rule_version_id = settings.rule_version_id
mapper.select:
select
order by settings.evaluation_year desc, settings.achievement_area_code, settings.achievement_category_code, settings.management_item_code, settings.researcher_count_band, settings.participation_type_code limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{ruleVersionId}

insert into participation_rate_operation_settings ( rule_version_id, evaluation_year, achievement_area_code, achievement_category_code, management_item_code, researcher_count_band, participation_type_code, distribution_rate, active_yn, change_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by ) values ( #{request.ruleVersionId}, (select to_char(effective_start_date, 'YYYY') from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = #{request.ruleVersionId}), #{request.achievementAreaCode}, #{request.achievementCategoryCode}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{rate.researcherCountBand}, #{rate.participationTypeCode}, #{rate.distributionRate}, 'Y', #{request.changeReason}, #{requestId}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} ) on conflict (rule_version_id, evaluation_year, achievement_area_code, achievement_category_code, management_item_code, researcher_count_band, participation_type_code) do update set distribution_rate = EXCLUDED.distribution_rate, active_yn = participation_rate_operation_settings.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by returning setting_id as "settingId", rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", (select version_code from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = participation_rate_operation_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionCode", (select version_status from evaluation_rule_versions where rule_version_id = participation_rate_operation_settings.rule_version_id) as "versionStatus", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", achievement_area_code as "achievementAreaCode", achievement_category_code as "achievementCategoryCode", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", researcher_count_band as "researcherCountBand", participation_type_code as "participationTypeCode", distribution_rate as "distributionRate", active_yn as "activeYn", change_reason as "changeReason", updated_by as "updatedBy", updated_at as "updatedAt"
